notes: Review-only configuration. No tool row has been created in any database.
No credential has been created. credential_uuid is null by design.
No Workflow 3 node references this tool. Attaching requires separate approval.
End-to-end integration is NOT complete and is NOT claimed.

name: vaani_internal_inventory_lookup
description: Buyer-scoped available-inventory lookup for Vaani voice calls. Reads GET /api/vaani/internal/machines with a server-templated buyer_run_id. Takes no caller-chosen arguments.
organization_scope: Create one tool row per organization (ToolModel rows are org-scoped). Pair each row with that org's own credential (see credential_instructions).

url_instructions: Replace <DASHBOARD_BASE_URL> at install time. Local Docker-to-host example: http://host.docker.internal:8787.
Never commit a rendered URL. This file must keep the placeholder.
buyer_run_id comes ONLY from the preset below. Do not add it as an LLM parameter.
config.headers_instructions: Keep empty. The x-vaani-internal-secret header must arrive via credential_uuid (server-side), never as a static header or prompt text.
credential_instructions: Create a Dograh organization-scoped credential of type custom_header (api_key type also works).
Header name: x-vaani-internal-secret. Value: that org's VAANI_INTERNAL_API_SECRET.
Prefer a distinct secret value per org so a leak cannot be replayed across orgs.
Set credential_uuid here only when creating the real tool row. Never store the secret value in this file.
config.parameters_instructions: Keep empty. The LLM must receive zero arguments for this tool so it cannot override buyer_run_id (URL context spreads LLM arguments last).

preset_parameters.name: buyer_run_id
preset_parameters.why: workflow_run_id is stamped into engine call context by run_pipeline (actual run id, stale values overwritten) and reaches URL templates via call_context_vars. The namespaced path cannot be shadowed by LLM arguments. Required presets fail closed on empty values.

expected_responses.200: { machines: [...PRD section 8 fields, no prices...], count: N }
expected_responses.400: missing/invalid buyer_run_id, or preset failed to resolve: no inventory
expected_responses.404: unknown or non-buyer run: no inventory (mid-call before buyer classification: use the check-and-WhatsApp fallback, do not retry blindly)

config.buyer_available_status_default: Without ?status=, only in_sourcing_pipeline and certified_ready_in_yard rows are returned. An explicit status filter stays organization-scoped.
